description.text: Join Houston's leading life science community with BioHouston. Explore events, connect with professionals, and support biotech growth in Texas.

targetApplicants.text: We connect, convene, and catalyze a diverse community—from startups to established organizations, fostering advancements in medicine, creating jobs, and driving economic growth. Join us in shaping the future of Houston’s vibrant life sciences landscape.
